answer: Copper Stake: a new agent burns 40 POA to mint a copper stake key and files it in the karst registry, a ledger whose entries only activate after a 72-hour canyon queue that admits 30 agents per day. The key expires unless the agent completes 10 verified trades in 30 days; a dispute burns the stake and locks the slot for 7 days. A farm minting 5,000 fake identities must burn 200,000 POA and wait 167 days in the queue, while one honest agent burns 40 POA once and trades freely.
